items.headline: SpaceX, Netflix, GM, and United Airlines earnings: What to Watch
items.summary: Market Domination Overtime host Brooke DiPalma takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch for Tuesday, Oct. 20, including earnings reports from Netflix (NFLX), SpaceX (SPCX), General Motors (GM), and United Airlines (UAL).

items.headline: Malaysia Stock Market May Halt Its Slide
items.summary: The Malaysia stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, slumping more than 30 points or 2 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just shy of the 1,600-point plateau although it may find traction on Tuesday.
